name: Tidalwave Brand
description: House typography, color and section styling for Tidalwave training documentation, plus markdown support for Obsidian List Callouts markers.
author: Sean

settings.name: List callout markers
settings.description: Characters that mark a list item as a callout when they appear at the start of the item followed by a space. Must match the markers configured in the Obsidian List Callouts plugin. Default covers the three in active use.
